title: Birthday Parties
summary: Mini golf, food, games, and plenty of room to celebrate.
detail: Kid parties, milestone birthdays and everything in between. Pick mini golf, bays or both, add food, and let us handle the setup and cleanup.

title: Corporate Outings & Retreats
summary: Skip the conference room. Bring the team out for golf, food, friendly competition, or a little of everything.
detail: Team building that people actually want to attend. Reserve a block of Toptracer bays, run a closest-to-the-pin contest, and feed everyone without anyone touching a slide deck.

title: Tent Rentals & Private Gatherings
summary: Our tent gives you space to make Creekside your own for celebrations, company events, family gatherings, and more.
detail: A covered, flexible space with room for tables, catering and a crowd. Showers, reunions, fundraisers, team banquets. If you can picture it, we can probably host it.
